details.description: Rerank 3.5 is Cohere's semantic reranking model, offered as a single multilingual model rather than separate English and multilingual variants. Given a query and a list of documents, it reorders the documents from most to least semantically relevant, and can rerank plain text, semi-structured data, and JSON documents. Cohere's documentation states it supports the languages covered by its embed-multilingual-v3.0 model, described elsewhere as over 100 languages. On Amazon Bedrock it is available as cohere.rerank-v3-5:0.
advantages: Uses a single multilingual model rather than separate English and multilingual variants, per Cohere's documentation.
Reranks semi-structured data and JSON documents in addition to plain text, per Cohere's documentation.
disadvantages: Cohere also offers newer rerank-v4.0-pro and rerank-v4.0-fast models alongside rerank-v3.5.
use_cases: Reordering search or retrieval results by relevance to a query.
Improving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines by reranking retrieved passages before they reach the generation model.
Reranking semi-structured or JSON records alongside plain-text documents.

sources.title: Supported Regions and models for reranking in Amazon Bedrock

notes: Cohere's own docs (docs.cohere.com/docs/rerank-2) give rerank-v3.5 a 4096-token context length per document with automatic truncation, and recommend under 1,000 documents per request; this differs from the catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 32000, so the catalog value was kept per instructions and the description avoids restating a token limit. Cohere lists rerank-v4.0-pro and rerank-v4.0-fast as newer models alongside rerank-v3.5, but no source marked v3.5 deprecated or legacy, so it is described as current.
